verdict.rationale: Unstructured offers deployment in your own dedicated instance or VPC with full data isolation, which indirectly lets you control where data resides. A community report also says self-hosting the official Docker image is hassle-free, another route to keeping data in your own environment. However, nothing documents an explicit region or residency selector for the hosted service, and the VPC/dedicated option is an enterprise tier priced through sales rather than a self-serve choice. Missing for 10: explicit region/data-residency selection (e.g. EU/US) in the SaaS, documented list of available regions, self-serve residency controls, independent corroboration of residency guarantees.
